Hannah: Quick update — SummitCare is live on Redwood Dedicated via the AWS Marketplace Private Offer in us-east-1 as of 11:10 UTC. Huge thanks to everyone. :tada:
Diego: Nice! Any initial perf/cost signals?
Rina: Early numbers: p95 latency for patient-summary generation ~160ms at 120 req/s. Token cost down ~45% compared to their previous endpoint after switching to int8 quantization + KV prefix caching.
OpsBot: deployment/summitcare/marketplace completed at 11:10:22 (duration 140s) :white_check_mark:
Ava: Deploy trace:
```
[11:07:02] provision dedicated pool: sc-pool-01
[11:08:10] deploy model: redwood-gpt-6b-0.9
[11:09:30] canary 10% -> health ok
[11:10:22] promote -> 100% traffic to sc-pool-01
[11:10:40] post-checks ok
```
Hannah: Product asked for a short one-liner + metric for the marketplace tile. Suggested: "SummitCare reduced inference costs by ~45% and improved p95 latency for summaries." Thoughts?
MarketingLead: Good start. Please get written permission before we publish the customer name. Also request a short quote from the PM.
Diego: Noted. Also FYI we enabled cross-region failover to us-west-2 and configured audit log exports to their KMS bucket. DR run scheduled next week.
Rina: I'll drop a 1-page perf + config summary into this thread in 30m (includes batching settings and KV cache policy).
Hannah: Thanks everyone. Once legal signs the quote, I'll share to #all-hands and #partners. Big win for the marketplace channel. :clap:
